settings.heading: Email Support
settings.text: Message our support inbox directly and we'll get back to you fast.

settings.question: Do I need an account to order?
settings.answer: No — you can check out as a guest. Creating an account just makes it faster to track future orders and reorder your favourites.

settings.question: How do I check my order status?
settings.answer: Log into your account, or use the Track Your Order box above with the order number or tracking code from your confirmation email.

settings.question: I didn't get an order confirmation email — what do I do?
settings.answer: Check your spam or promotions folder first. If you still can't find it, email us and we'll resend it right away.

settings.question: Can I change my email or shipping address after ordering?
settings.answer: Email us as soon as possible after placing your order — we can usually update it if the order hasn't shipped yet.

settings.question: How do I create an account?
settings.answer: Click "Log in" at the top of any page and select "Create account". You can also create one at checkout.

settings.question: When will my order be shipped?
settings.answer: Orders are typically processed and shipped within 1–2 business days of being placed.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Delivery times vary by location, but most orders arrive within 5–9 business days after shipping.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: Use the Track Your Order box above, or log into your account to see the latest status on any order.

settings.question: Can I cancel or change my order after placing it?
settings.answer: Email us right away — we can usually make changes if the order hasn't shipped yet, but can't guarantee it once it's on its way.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Shipping availability depends on your location. Enter your address at checkout to see if delivery is available to you.

settings.question: Where is my order being shipped from?
settings.answer: Orders ship from our fulfillment centre and are handed off to our shipping partners for delivery to your door.

settings.question: How often should I use Corvina?
settings.answer: Use it in place of your regular shampoo, 2–3 times a week, until you reach your desired shade — then use as needed to maintain it.

settings.question: Who should avoid this product?
settings.answer: If you're pregnant, breastfeeding, or have a scalp condition, check with a doctor before use. Always patch test first if you have sensitive skin.

settings.question: Can I use it on colour-treated or chemically processed hair?
settings.answer: Yes. Corvina is gentle enough for colour-treated, permed, or relaxed hair, though we always recommend a patch test first.

settings.question: Will it stain my skin or towels?
settings.answer: Rinse thoroughly after use and avoid leaving it on skin or fabric for extended periods, the same as with any hair colour product.

settings.question: How should I store it?
settings.answer: Keep in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and heat. Reseal the bottle tightly after each use.

settings.question: How long before I see a difference?
settings.answer: Most people notice a difference after a few uses, with colour building gradually the more consistently it's used.

settings.question: What ingredients are in Corvina?
settings.answer: Corvina is formulated with Polygonum multiflorum (he shou wu), coffee bean oil, and henna leaf extract, along with gentle cleansing agents — no ammonia.

settings.question: Is Corvina cruelty-free?
settings.answer: Yes — Corvina is not tested on animals.

settings.question: Where does this product come from?
settings.answer: Corvina is developed using traditional botanical ingredients long used in natural hair care, blended into a modern wash-in formula.

settings.question: Is the product tested for quality and safety?
settings.answer: Yes — every batch goes through quality checks before it ships.

settings.question: What's your return policy?
settings.answer: If you're not happy with your order, reach out within 30 days of delivery and we'll make it right — see our Refund Policy for full details.

settings.question: How do I request a refund?
settings.answer: Email us with your order number and we'll walk you through the next steps.

settings.question: Why does the price on the website differ from what I saw on social media?
settings.answer: Promotional pricing shown in ads or social posts is only valid through that specific link — prices on the website reflect our current standing offers.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards, as well as Shop Pay and other secure checkout options available at checkout.
